text: VERIFIED BY THE CHIEF against source, not accepted on report. NodeSummary.discoursePosition is a PER-LEVEL rank: StorySourceView.levelRank groups by source.levelOf and zipWithIndex within each group, and the documented contract in source.scala says so outright - 'the rank of the node's first mention among all nodes at its level (0-based)'. embed-bench/metrics.scala:283 feeds that field into stepDirection for both gold and inferred steps. For any gold step between nodes at DIFFERENT levels the two ranks are drawn from different scales and start at 0 independently, so the computed direction can be reversed or spuriously equal. This is the estimand class again: a model-comparison number that is silently wrong on ordinary inputs, not only under adversarial input, and it mis-ranks channels rather than failing. BLAST RADIUS BOUNDED TO ONE SITE, checked rather than assumed: the only other consumer of the field, StorySourceView.worldOrder line 268, uses it purely as a tie-break among narrated-world SITUATIONS, which are all level 0, so that comparison is same-axis and correct; wire.scala only serializes the field and AlignGens only mutates it. FIX AXIS: SourceView.relativePosition, the support-midpoint axis in [0,1] already used by RecallSignature and hsmm, which is level-independent. IDENTITY REQUIREMENT per ADR 0003: the corrected metric must NOT silently reuse the same name and definition. Published values were wrong, so a consumer holding an old number must be able to tell. Remove the broken metric and publish the corrected one under a name that states the axis; a metric that is wrong is retired, never kept alongside its replacement where someone could still cite it.
